title: Blow Series
meta: Framing: Set in custom black wood frame
statement:
This piece doesn't whisper — it blows. Part pop symbol, part cosmic riddle, BLOW is about expression, release, and not taking things too seriously. With its exaggerated red lips, radiant circles, and punchy center word, the work plays with energy, pleasure, and layered meaning.

It's cheeky. It's loud. It's about letting go of control — and maybe just letting it all blow up, blow out, or blow your mind. Whether you see it as sensual, spiritual, or just straight-up bold, BLOW dares you to feel something… and not overthink it.
